title: Introducing Tessl Spec Registry
description:
Coding agents are powerful, but only when they have the right context.

They might miss the latest open-source library updates, your team’s framework conventions, or company-specific workflows.

The Tessl Spec Registry solves this by making that missing context part of your software project. It packages specs — like reusable instructions, workflows, and policies — just like dependencies, so every agent has the knowledge to code correctly.

In this beta overview, we cover:
- Why agents struggle without shared context
- How the Spec Registry makes knowledge part of your software
- What specs include, from library usage guides to company policies
- How 10,000+ specs already improve agent reliability and speed for open source libraries

Tessl Spec Registry is now available in beta, free to use.

Learn more and get started at tessl.io/registry
